scope: Fake/local test harness reliability experiment only
question: Does polling the same dispatch call until its atomic report is finalized (within existing 10s caller-result window), then draining the detached exact dispatch and close operation within 30s during teardown, eliminate premature report-temp cleanup while preserving all callback, release/recovery, oracle, and replay safeguards?
pass_rule: Sample pass requires exit0, unittest OK, original semantic assertions (single effect, exact recovery release/horizon, source UNKNOWN/null, no replay, oracle), and reports finalized. Any failure remains in denominator.
baseline: R09 tracked API futures, but dispatch result report still had a separate in-flight worker
design: Keep 8s API Future result timeout and 10s exact-result polling window. Replace the premature fixed 2s inner report-finalization assertion with a continue-poll-until-report-finalized condition within the same 10s deadline.

On teardown, wait up to 30s for each already-issued exact dispatch report to have report.json and no report temp before requesting close. Retry only close when it returns busy; never retry observe/dispatch or task effect.
Track/drain API futures as in R05/R09.
Run 5 normal + 5 -O interleaved, fresh process each; no retries/replacements.
